items.title: Meeting on security guarantees for Ukraine to take place on 4 November
items.teaser: A meeting to discuss security guarantees for Ukraine will be held at the European Commission headquarters in Brussels on 4 November, ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Feuer und Explosionen nach Treffer auf Stützpunkt russischer Einheit, die Krim-Brücke bewacht
items.teaser: In Kertsch auf der anektierten Krim ist ein Stüptzpunkt russischer Invasoren, die Krim-Brücke bewachen, angegriffen worden.

items.title: Zelenskyy confirms Ukraine hacked Russian warning system in retaliation
items.teaser: Following unauthorised alerts regarding radiation threats in Ukraine, President Zelenskyy has confirmed Kyiv struck back against Russia's emergency systems.

items.title: Kremlin sees “no similar plans” after Oleshky—Kyiv plans to set up a center to return civilians Russia holds
items.teaser: Families of detained Ukrainians will get one office to turn to, the ombudsman says. Russia will have no part in building it.

items.title: Zelensky arrives in Berlin
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has arrived in Berlin.

items.title: Search and rescue operation completed in Dnipro, two killed and 20 injured
items.teaser: Emergency services have completed search operations in Dnipro, treating 14 hospital patients – including three in a serious condition – following extensive infrastructure strikes.

items.title: Selenskyj zu massivem Angriff Russlands: Hauptziel waren Energieanlagen, Stromerzeugung und Umspannwerke
items.teaser: „Allein in der vergangenen Nacht haben die Russen 289 Angriffsdrohnen, 17 ballistische Raketen und 59 Marschflugkörper abgefeuert. Das Hauptziel war der Energiesektor, Stromerzeugungsanlagen und Umspannwerke in den Regionen Odessa, Tscherkassy, Schytomyr, Winnyzja, Charkiw, Dnipro, Tscherniwzi, Tschernihiw und Riwne“,

items.title: Zelensky confirms resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries
items.teaser: Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries in response to continued Russian attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure.

items.title: Russia ends free bottled gas for 13 groups of Crimeans before winter. In one village, a gas cylinder costs up to four times the official price—a local resident
items.teaser: Prices have risen for every fuel Crimeans use to heat homes during power outages, Crimean media report.

items.title: Zelenskyy and his team arrive in Berlin
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has arrived in Berlin, where he is due to meet Friedrich Merz, Frank-Walter Steinmeier and Julia Klöckner and attend the Berlin Security Conference.

items.title: Russia unleashes biggest mass attack on Ukraine's energy this year
items.teaser: Energy officials recorded one of the largest waves of Russian ballistic missiles targeting critical infrastructure, with Russia also launching cruise missiles, jet-powered drones, and propeller-powered drones, Vitalii Zaichenko, CEO of Ukrenergo, the country's state grid operator, told the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: Warnungen vor Sabotage und bewaffneten Eindringlingen: Polen stationiert Anti-Terror-Polizei nahe der russischen Grenze
items.teaser: Polen verstärkt seine Sicherheitsmaßnahmen an der Grenze zu Kaliningrad. Hintergrund sind Warnungen vor möglichen Sabotageakten und dem Eindringen bewaffneter Gruppen.

items.title: Russian forces may be planning new landing attempts in Kherson's Korabel district – South Group of Forces
items.teaser: Russian troops are making preparations that may indicate an intention to establish a foothold on the right bank of the Dnipro River in the Kherson region, build up forces in the Korabel district of Kherson, and use it as a potential bridgehead for further operations aimed at capturing the city.

items.title: Handy-Spionage verhindern: Diese Maßnahmen schützen Sie
items.teaser: Von heimlicher Standortüberwachung bis zum Mitlesen von Nachrichten: Schon einfache Maßnahmen können verhindern, dass Fremde Ihr Smartphone ausspähen.

items.title: Drei Wärmekraftwerke stellen nach russischen Angriffen Betrieb ein
items.teaser: In der Nacht auf den 3. November haben die Russen drei Wärmekraftwerke der DTEK-Gruppe angegriffen.

items.title: Ukraine hacked Russia's emergency alert system in response to Russian cyberattack – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukraine hacked Russia's emergency alert system in response to a Russian cyberattack on November 1. The hack was a response to Russia sending fake nuclear threat warnings to Ukrainian users.

items.title: Russia kept troops at an aviation school beside Luhansk’s dead airfield. A week after the last strike, Ukraine hit the area again
items.teaser: The first attack lasted for hours and hit the city’s power, and this time Ukrainian monitors caught the fire on video from the edge of town.

items.title: 2060 Soldaten: Russlands Verluste seit gestern
items.teaser: Die Zahl der getöteten oder verletzten russischen Soldaten ist seit dem 24. Februar 2022 auf 1. 594. 830 gestiegen. Allein innerhalb von 24 Stunden beträgt die Zahl der Verluste 2 060.

items.title: Death toll from Komyshuvakha airstrike rises to 31, nearly 50 people missing
items.teaser: A search-and-rescue operation is underway at the site of an airstrike in Komyshuvakha. So far, 31 people have been confirmed killed, while nearly 50 others are missing.

items.title: Hours before Americans vote, Russia fires 59 cruise missiles at Ukraine’s grid and bombs a Kharkiv hospital
items.teaser: Missiles and drones went after power plants and substations, and a guided bomb landed between two hospital buildings in Kharkiv.

items.title: Russian attack hits energy infrastructure in 10 regions – Energy Ministry
items.teaser: Russia's large-scale missile and drone attack targeted power plants, substations and combined heat and power plants (CHPs) across 10 Ukrainian regions. Emergency power outages were introduced in Kyiv and six regions as a result of the damage.

items.title: Ukraine-Krieg: USA bringen Moskau und Kyjiw an einen Tisch
items.teaser: Im zähen diplomatischen Ringen um ein Ende des russischen Angriffskriegs gegen die Ukraine könnte es bald etwas Bewegung geben. Die Multinationale Ukraine-Truppe konzentriert sich bereits auf die Friedenssicherung.

items.title: Three DTEK power plants halt generation after large-scale Russian attack
items.teaser: Three thermal power plants operated by DTEK Group were targeted in a Russian attack overnight into November 3.

items.title: FM Sybiha calls Russia’s deliberate pre-winter attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure clear sign of genocide
items.teaser: Russia’s targeted attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure, aimed at depriving the population of electricity and heating on the eve of winter, are one of the direct signs of genocide.

items.title: Energieinfrastruktur in mehreren Regionen der Ukraine bei russischen Angriffen beschädigt
items.teaser: In der Nacht hat Russland mehrere Regionen der Ukraine mit massiven Luftangriffen überzogen. Im Visier stand vor allem Energieinfrastruktur.

items.title: Russian forces strike civilian infrastructure in Chernihiv region early in morning
items.teaser: Early this morning, Russian troops launched a drone strike on a farm building and a house in one of the villages of the Kiptivka community in Chernihiv region.

items.title: Bereits 73 Verletzte nach russischem Angriff auf Krankenhaus in Charkiw
items.teaser: Durch einen russischen Angriff in der Nacht auf den 3. November auf ein Krankenhaus in Charkiw sind 73 Menschen verletzt worden, teilt das Büro des Generalstaatsanwalts auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Generalstab meldet 206 Gefechte an der Front in den vergangenen 24 Stunden, die meisten - bei Kostjantyniwka
items.teaser: In den vergangenen 24 Stunden haben entlang der Front 206 Zusammenstöße zwischen den ukrainischen und russischen Streitkräften stattgefunden, teilt der ukrainische Generalstab auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Costa Rica’s First Investment Arbitration Set-Aside Proceeding and the End of the Investor-State Exclusion
items.teaser: In September 2026, the First Chamber of the Supreme Court of Costa Rica (“ Sala Primera ”) issued the first decision by a Costa Rican court on the annulment of an investment arbitration award. The case, Castillo Bozo v. Panama, put an unusual feature of Costa Rica’s arbitration legislation under direct scrutiny: the no

items.title: Russian forces damage DTEK facility in southern Odesa region
items.teaser: Russian troops damaged a DTEK Odesa Power Grid facility, causing power outages.

items.title: Russen beschießen fünf Ortschaften und töten vier Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 02. November töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk vier Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: Zelenskyy says Russia launched 17 ballistic missiles against Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has clarified that the Russians conducted attacks using 17 ballistic missiles among other weapons on the night of 2-3 November.

items.title: Zelensky to visit Berlin on Nov. 3, German chancellor says
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky is due to visit Berlin on Nov. 3, according to German Chancellor Friedrich Merz.

items.title: Drone attack sparks fire at one of Russia’s largest oil refineries in Yaroslavl, media report
items.teaser: On the night of November 2, drones attacked the Yaroslavl Oil Refinery, one of the five largest in Russia. A fire broke out at the facility, which supplies fuel, including for military aircraft and equipment.

items.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy to make surprise Berlin visit this Tuesday, Merz says
items.teaser: Chancellor Friedrich Merz said the Ukrainian president is due to arrive in Germany around midday amid a renewed push for peace talks with Moscow.

items.title: Merz kündigt Selenskyj-Besuch in Berlin an
items.teaser: Vor einer neuen Verhandlungsrunde mit Russland und den USA trifft Selenskyj Kanzler Merz in Berlin. Es geht um Sicherheitsgarantien, Flugabwehr und weitere Milliardenhilfen.

items.title: Eine der größten russischen Ölraffinerien brennt nach Drohnenangriff
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 3. November haben Drohnen die Raffinerie Slavneft-Yanos in der russischen Stadt Jaroslawl attackiert - eine der fünf größten in Russland. Auf dem Gelände der Anlage, die unter anderem Treibstoff für Militärflugzeuge und -technik liefert, brach ein Feuer aus, wie der Telegram-Kanal ASTRA berichtet.

items.title: Strack-Zimmermann zur Ukraine: Warum der Druck auf Putin steigen muss
items.teaser: Strack-Zimmermann zur Ukraine: Warum der Druck auf Putin steigen muss

items.title: Repairing and Re-pairing: Collective Remedies for Greenland’s Forced Contraception Cases
items.teaser: Since late August, the debate about Greenland’s forced contraception cases has focused almost exclusively on one question, namely whether Denmark committed genocide. items.title: Russian attack on Dnipro injures 15, three in serious condition
items.teaser: In Dnipro, the number of people wounded as a result of the Russian attack on the morning of November 3 has risen to 15.

items.title: Kazakhstan suspends oil supplies to Russia amid drone attacks
items.teaser: Kazakhstan has temporarily suspended the transport of crude oil to Russia via the Atyrau–Samara pipeline following a drone attack on the morning of 2 November.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,594,830 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,060 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: 15 Verletzte und starke Schäden nach russischen Angriffen auf Region Dnipro
items.teaser: Die russische Armee hat am Dienstagmorgen die Stadt Dnipro erneut angegriffen. Mehrere Wohnhäuser wurden beschädigt, es gibt 15 Verletzte unter der zivilen Bevölkerung, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Oleksandr Hanzha, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Russia strikes Ukrenergo substation in Rivne Oblast
items.teaser: An overnight Russian attack has damaged an electricity substation in Rivne Oblast, where one of Ukraine's three nuclear power plants is located.

items.title: In Region Cherson sieben Zivilisten verletzt, 29 Ortschaften beschossen
items.teaser: Letzten Tag beschoss die russische Besatzungsarmee 29 Siedlungen in der Region Cherson. Bei Beschuss wurden sieben Zivilisten verletzt.

items.title: Russian strike on Kharkiv hospital raises injury toll to 73
items.teaser: In Kharkiv, 73 people were injured as a result of a Russian attack on the night of November 3.

items.title: Ukraine's air defence downs 309 Russian aerial threats, including three ballistic missiles: strikes recorded at 23 locations
items.teaser: Russia launched a large-scale combined attack involving ballistic and cruise missiles and 289 drones overnight. Strikes were recorded at 23 locations.

items.title: Ukraine, Iran und Co.: So könnten die Midterms die US-Außenpolitik beeinflussen
items.teaser: Donald Trumps Republikaner kontrollieren den US-Kongress, doch nach den Zwischenwahlen könnte sich das ändern. Das hätte nicht nur Einfluss auf die Amerikaner, sondern auch auf Kriegsschauplätze in Europa und Nahost.

items.title: Zahl der Toten bei Luftangriffen auf Komyschuwacha in Region Saporischschja steigt auf 29
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Todesopfer durch mehrere russische Luftangriffe auf das Dorf Komyschuwacha in Region Saporischschja am 2. November ist auf 29 gestiegen, teilt der Ko-Vorsitzende des Verteidigungsrats der Region , Iwan Fedorow, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Russians launch repeat attack on energy facility in Odesa Oblast
items.teaser: Oleh Kiper has confirmed extensive equipment damage and power disruptions after Russian forces target a key energy facility.

items.title: War update: 206 clashes on front line over past day, fiercest fighting in Kostiantynivka sector
items.teaser: A total of 206 combat engagements took place along the front line over the past day. Russian forces were most active in the Kostiantynivka sector, where they launched 21 attacks.

items.title: Germany news: Ukraine in focus at Berlin Security Conference
items.teaser: A security conference in the German capital is to examine ways of defending against threats from Russia. The justice minister has put forward a bill that would raise penalties for sexual offenses. DW has more.

items.title: Russian forces strike Dnipro at dawn, injuring at least 15 people – photos
items.teaser: Residential buildings and civilian infrastructure facilities were damaged in a Russian strike on Dnipro early on 3 November. Search and rescue efforts are underway amid the threat of further attacks.

items.title: Kombinierter russischer Angriff auf Charkiw: 62 Menschen in medizinischer Einrichtung verletzt
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Angriff auf eine medizinische Einrichtung im Stadtbezitk Nemyschljanskyi in Charkiw sind 62 Menschen verletzt worden. Über 220 Patienten wurden in andere Krankenhäuser evakuiert, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Oleh Synehubow, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Russian attack leaves 130 settlements without power in Zhytomyr region
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an energy facility in the Zhytomyr region overnight on November 3, leaving 130 settlements without electricity.

items.title: Russians strike medical facility in Kharkiv: 73 people injured, over 200 patients evacuated – photos
items.teaser: A Russian attack damaged a medical facility in Kharkiv overnight, injuring dozens of people and prompting the evacuation of more than 200 patients.

items.title: Russia conducted 206 combat clashes on 10 fronts over the past day
items.teaser: General Staff has reported heavy combat across the front line, with Russian forces launching 21 attacks on Kostiantynivka front and 13 on Pokrovsk front.

items.title: As Moldova speeds past Ukraine on reforms, Brussels set to reveal verdict on Kyiv's EU progress
items.teaser: The EU’s Nov. 4 Enlargement Package will grade Ukraine’s accession progress and will likely show how far Moldova has outpaced Kyiv on reforms.

items.title: Russian attacks damage homes and power lines in Cherkasy, two people injured
items.teaser: Two people were injured in a Russian drone strike on the city of Cherkasy.

items.title: Die juristische Presseschau vom 3. November 2026: Gesetzentwurf zum Sexualstrafrecht / BGH zu Sanktionen gegen Alischer Usmanow / VGH Hessen klärt Zuständigkeit für Linken-Klage
items.teaser: BMJ plant Bestrafung verbaler sexueller Belästigung. LG Hamburg muss Unterlassungsklage gegen EU-Sanktionen zustellen. Laut VGH Hessen ist das VG Wiesbaden doch für die Klage der Linken gegen den hessischen Innenminister zuständig.

items.title: In Region Saporischschja 47 Ortschaften beschossen, 26 Zivilisten getötet, elf verletzt
items.teaser: Am vergangenen Tag beschossen die russischen Besatzungstruppen 47 Ortschaften in der Region Saporischschja 930 Mal.

items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,060 over past day
items.teaser: Russia’s total combat losses since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, have reached approximately 1,594,830 personnel as of November 3, 2026, including 2,060 troops killed or wounded over the past day.

items.title: Drone crashes in Latvia: NATO aircraft and interceptor drones deployed
items.teaser: Latvia issued an air-raid warning in two eastern municipalities overnight after an unidentified drone entered its airspace and crashed near the Russian border.

items.title: "The scale of this tragedy is horrifying": 29 killed in Komyshuvakha, 48 people missing
items.teaser: Five people have been injured and 48 remain missing following Russian airstrikes on the settlement in Zaporizhzhia Oblast. Search and rescue operations are continuing.

items.title: Russian forces launch repeated strike on Dnipro, leaving people injured
items.teaser: Russian forces launched another attack on Dnipro in the morning, damaging residential buildings and injuring civilians.

items.title: Power outages and water supply disruptions in Kharkiv
items.teaser: Kharkiv City Council has reported partial suspensions of heating and hot water supplies alongside metro service disruptions following Russian strikes on energy facilities.

items.title: Emergency power cuts introduced in Kyiv and two oblasts
items.teaser: Kyiv, Kyiv Oblast and Dnipropetrovsk Oblast have been placed under emergency electricity restrictions following an order from Ukraine's national grid operator.

items.title: Poland deploys counterterrorism police near Russian border amid sabotage warnings
items.teaser: According to RMF FM, Polish military intelligence and allied intelligence services warned last week that acts of sabotage could occur near the Russian border, potentially including incursions by armed groups.

items.title: Ukraine intercepts 66% of Russia’s jet-powered Shahed drones in October – General Staff
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces destroyed 4,859 Shahed-type drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine during October.

items.title: Russians attacked 17 settlements in Sumy Oblast over the past day: one killed and several injured – photos
items.teaser: National Police has reported one fatality in Mykolaivka hromada and multiple injuries, including a child, following Russian drone and artillery attacks on Sumy Oblast.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian attack on Kharkiv rises to 62
items.teaser: The number of people injured after a medical facility in Kharkiv’s Nemyshlianskyi district was hit has risen to 62, while more than 220 patients are being evacuated to other hospitals.

items.title: Russia loses 2,060 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 2,060 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Putin panicking ahead of U.S. elections – Congressman Whitesides
items.teaser: Russian President Vladimir Putin is panicking as he anticipates a change in the composition of the U.S. Congress and, together with President Donald Trump, is trying to force Ukraine into making unfavorable concessions before the newly elected Congress begins its session in January, Democratic Congressman George Whites

items.title: Kharkiv hit by Russian attack, medical facility struck, casualties reported
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a massive attack on Kharkiv with ballistic missiles and guided aerial bombs, with one of the strikes hitting a medical facility in the Nemyshlianskyi district, leaving people injured.

items.title: Drones attack one of Russia's five largest oil refineries supplying its defence industry – photos, videos
items.teaser: The Yaroslavl refinery, one of Russia's five largest oil processing plants and a supplier to its defence industry, was targeted overnight.

items.title: US-Vermittler Witkoff kündigt Gespräche mit Russland und Ukraine an
items.teaser: Die USA, Russland und die Ukraine haben zuletzt im Februar im Dreierformat miteinander gesprochen. Kommende Woche wollen sie wieder zusammenkommen. US-Sondergesandter Witkoff nennt konkrete Ziele.

items.title: Russian missile attack hits Kharkiv medical facility, 62 reported injured
items.teaser: Terekhov said approximately 200 patients would be evacuated to other medical facilities as emergency services worked at the scene.

items.title: Up to four groups of power cuts scheduled across Ukraine on Tuesday – Ukrenergo
items.teaser: Electricity consumption restrictions will be in effect in some regions of Ukraine on Tuesday, November 3, from 00:00 to 23:59.

items.title: Czech PM outlines army priorities for coming years
items.teaser: The priorities for developing the Czech Armed Forces are increasing troop numbers and strengthening air defence.

items.title: Russian oil refinery in Yaroslavl reportedly struck, multiple fires reported
items.teaser: Ukraine has repeatedly targeted the facility, including most recently, a Sept. 17 strike that damaged its AVT-3 crude oil processing unit, according to Ukraine's General Staff.

items.title: Russia attacks critical infrastructure facilities in Dnipro and Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, people injured
items.teaser: Russian forces targeted critical infrastructure facilities in Dnipro and Kryvyi Rih district overnight, then launched further strikes on the city in the early morning, damaging houses and injuring residents.

items.title: EU sanctions against ISIL/Da’esh and Al-Qaeda: Council renews regime until 2027
items.teaser: The Council extended restrictive measures against individuals and groups associated with ISIL/Da'esh and Al-Qaeda for a further year, until 31 October 2027.

items.title: USA: Kommende Woche Verhandlungen mit Ukraine und Russland
items.teaser: In den stockenden Verhandlungen um ein Ende des Ukraine-Krieges haben die USA für kommende Woche neue Dreiergespräche mit der Ukraine und Russland angekündigt.

items.title: Ukraine to establish center for return of civilian detainees
items.teaser: Following the humanitarian mission to Oleshky, Ukraine will establish a separate Center for the Return of Civilian Citizens of Ukraine, which will operate under the Ombudsman's Office.

items.title: Putin orders Russian data centers to reserve capacity to assist state IT infrastructure
items.teaser: With the decree, a newly established government commission will have the authority to claim reserved capacity, which must be made accessible within 24 hours of the government's notification.

items.title: Odesa to receive 20 buses from Romania’s Galati for public transport during blackouts
items.teaser: Odesa and the Romanian city of Galați are launching a partnership in the areas of municipal services, transportation, infrastructure restoration, culture, and education.

items.title: Russian attack sets house ablaze in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, injuring child – photo
items.teaser: A house caught fire after Russian forces attacked a residential property in the Zaporizhzhia district on the evening of 2 November. Firefighters have extinguished the blaze.

items.title: Witkoff reveals location, date for new trilateral peace deal negotiations
items.teaser: U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff announced on Nov. 3 that new rounds of trilateral peace negotiations between Russia, Ukraine, and the U.S. will be held on Nov. 10 in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Russian forces attack Khmelnytskyi Oblast, damaging apartment block
items.teaser: Windows in a residential building and a passenger car were damaged in the Shepetivka district during a Russian attack on the evening of 2 November. No casualties have been reported.

items.title: Ukraine and Russia will hold talks in Abu Dhabi with US mediation – Witkoff
items.teaser: US Special Envoy Steve Witkoff has announced working-level discussions between Ukrainian and Russian representatives, with security arrangements and humanitarian measures among the topics.

items.title: SBU detains former sailor in Odesa suspected of directing Russian attacks
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine's (SBU) military counterintelligence unit has detained a former merchant ship sailor in Odesa who is suspected of helping Russia direct its strikes.

items.title: Zelensky confirms Ukraine targeted Russian emergency alert systems in retaliatory hack
items.teaser: Late on Nov. 1, Ukraine's Air Alert app, which provides vital updates to citizens about incoming Russian strikes, was hacked. Hours after the false warnings were sent to Ukrainian citizens' phones, Russia's own air raid alert system began to show signs of being compromised.

items.title: Russian drone debris falls in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district, sparking fire
items.teaser: Grass caught fire in an open area of Kyiv after debris from a Russian drone attack fell in the Darnytskyi district on the evening of 2 November.

items.title: Intelligence reveals details of Russian Gerbera-2 drone with range of up to 1,200 km
items.teaser: The Ukrainian Defense Ministry's Main Intelligence Directorate (HUR) has released information about the components of the Russian Gerbera-type unmanned aerial vehicle.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1713: Ukraine hits Samara Oil hub blending up to half of Russian crude exports
items.teaser: Russia struck a school in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, where civilians had been receiving aid, killing 26 people.

items.title: Failing Ukrainian brigade cut unauthorized absences by 70%. How did they do it?
items.teaser: The 53rd Mechanized Brigade, once scattered and losing positions, now leads Ukraine’s Ground Forces in soldiers returning to the ranks.

items.title: Ukraine: At least 26 killed in Russian strikes on aid center
items.teaser: At least 26 people were killed in Russian airstrikes on a school that was serving as an aid distribution center in Zaporizhzhia, a southern Ukrainian region. DW has more.

items.title: Netherlands seeks ways to speed up delivery of Patriot missiles to Ukraine
items.teaser: Dutch Defence Minister Dilan Yeşilgöz-Zegerius said that the Netherlands and its partners are exploring ways to accelerate the delivery of missiles for Patriot air defence systems to Ukraine.

items.title: War update: 191 clashes on front line
items.teaser: There have been 191 combat engagements on the front line, with the Defence Forces repelling nearly 20 enemy assaults in the Kostiantynivka sector.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Russia strikes school where civilians recieved aid in Zaporizhzhia Oblast days after Oleshky truce. Nine more bombs hit its shelter, killing at least 26
items.teaser: The strike on Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, comes days after a rare truce let civilians out of occupied Oleshky.

items.title: "Terrorismus in Reinform": Baby stirbt bei Bombenanschlag in Kolumbien
items.teaser: Vier Menschen sterben, als in Kolumbien eine Autobombe explodiert. Die Regierung der Provinz Tolima sieht die Verantwortung bei Dissidentengruppen einer früheren Guerillaorganisation. Bekannt hat sich zu dem Anschlag jedoch noch niemand.

items.title: Death toll from Russian strikes on school in Komyshuvakha rises to 24
items.teaser: The death toll from Russian strikes on an educational institution in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region, on November 2 has risen to 24.

items.title: 15-kilometer flight into kill zone: Ukraine’s drone rescues wounded soldier by air
items.teaser: Andrii, callsign Donbas, had lost a foot and could not be reached by vehicles.

items.title: Germany and UK prepare plan to strengthen Ukraine’s air defence ahead of next Ukraine Defence Contact Group meeting – Pistorius
items.teaser: Germany and the United Kingdom are working to secure additional air defence capabilities for Ukraine amid insufficient deliveries of Patriot systems and missiles from the United States. They hope to have a plan ready by the next meeting of the Ukraine Defence Contact Group on November 17.

items.title: Russia prepares new massive strike on energy and logistics infrastructure – Zelensky
items.teaser: Russia is preparing a new large-scale attack on Ukraine, with energy infrastructure and logistics likely to be the main targets.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Russia planning new large-scale attack on Ukraine targeting energy and logistics infrastructure
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says intelligence indicates Russia is preparing to carry out another large-scale strike. He has called for stronger pressure on Russia’s oil and gas revenues to deter further attacks.

items.title: Teenager injured in Russian attack on Kyiv region
items.teaser: A 15-year-old boy was injured in a Russian attack in the Bucha district of Kyiv region.

items.title: Ukraine meldet mindestens 24 Tote bei Angriff in Region Saporischschja
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Angriff in der Region Saporischschja sind der Ukraine zufolge mindestens 24 Menschen getötet worden. Präsident Selenskyj warf Moskau gezieltes Bombardement vor - demnach traf die Attacke ein Verteilzentrum für Hilfsgüter.

items.title: Zaporizhzhia region declares Day of Mourning for victims of Komyshuvakha attack
items.teaser: November 3 has been declared a Day of Mourning in the Zaporizhzhia region for those killed in the attack on Komyshuvakha earlier this morning.

items.title: Ukraine: Dutzende Tote bei russischem Luftangriff
items.teaser: Mindestens 24 Menschen sind bei einem Angriff in der Region Saporischschja gestorben. Selenskyj wirft Russland gezieltes Bombardieren einer Ausgabestelle für humanitäre Hilfe vor.

items.title: Bereits 24 Tote nach russischem Bombenangriff auf Schule in Komyschuwacha
items.teaser: In Komyschuwacha, Region Saporischschja, ist die Zahl der Todesopfer nach russischen Angriffen auf eine Bildungseinrichtung am 2. November auf 24 gestiegen.

items.title: Extremismus - Jugendliche wegen möglicher Anschlagspläne gegen Flüchtlingsheime in Verdacht
items.teaser: Die Strafverfolgungsbehörden in Niedersachsen und Schleswig-Holstein ermitteln gegen zwei junge Männer wegen der möglichen Vorbereitung eines Anschlags.

items.title: Some Oleshky residents remain seeking evacuation, others still on the road to Ukraine, Lubinets says
items.teaser: The exact number of people still remaining in Oleshky cannot currently be verified, Lubinets said, answering a question from the Kyiv Independent. Ukraine also cannot reveal the number of evacuees as stipulated by an agreement with Russia, he added.

items.title: Festnahme nach mutmaßlich rechtsextremem Anschlagsplan
items.teaser: Gewaltfantasien gegen Migranten und konkrete Anschlagspläne: Zwei junge Männer haben sich in Chatnachrichten ausgetauscht und sind ins Visier der Ermittler geraten. Ein 15-Jähriger sitzt jetzt in Untersuchungshaft.

items.title: Polizei verhindert mutmaßlich rechtsextremen Anschlag in Niedersachsen
items.teaser: Chatnachrichten, die dem NDR vorliegen, zeigen, wie konkret die Pläne offenbar schon waren. Nach Hinweisen griff die Polizei ein. Ein Jugendlicher sitzt in U-Haft.

items.title: Ukrainian Congress Committee of America urge Governor Hochul to help block 140,000-ton Russian diesel shipment bound for Port of New York on 6-7 November
items.teaser: With Russian fuel flowing back to US ports, Ukrainian-Americans protest from New York to Rome against the diesel deal.

items.title: Ukraine to see temperatures ranging from 0°C to +15°C on Tuesday
items.teaser: Cloudy weather is expected across Ukraine on Tuesday, November 3, with no significant precipitation forecast.

items.title: Russische Besatzer griffen Region Dnipropetrowsk mehr als 40 Mal an, es gibt Tote und Verletzte
items.teaser: Russische Besatzungstruppen attackierten drei Landkreise der Region Dnipropetrowsk mehr als 40 Mal mit Drohnen und beschossen mit Artillerie. Eine Person wurde getötet, drei weitere wurden verletzt, meldete der Leiter der Militärverwaltung der Region Dnipropetrowsk, Oleksandr Ganscha, auf Telegram.

items.title: Confrontation involving National Guard soldiers unfolds near Kyiv, police deny hostage reports
items.teaser: Videos circulating on social media appear to show a tense standoff, with people demanding access to the building.

items.title: Death toll from Russian strike on School in Komyshuvakha rises to 24
items.teaser: The death toll from Russian strikes on an educational institution in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region, on November 2 has risen to 24.

items.title: Some American media figures are “directly or indirectly” financed by Russia, says Trump-linked blogger Loomer
items.teaser: Russia directly or indirectly finances many US media figures, she claims.

items.title: 'Exceptionally horrific strike' — Russian bombs strike school used as humanitarian aid center in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, killing 24
items.teaser: Following the initial strike, Russian forces dropped another nine aerial bombs on a shelter where people were taking refuge, Zelensky said.

items.title: Luftverteidigung schießt ab/neutralisiert binnen des Tages 139 Drohnen und acht Banderol-Raketen
items.teaser: Binnen des Tages des 2. November griffen russische Streitkräfte die Ukraine mit 171 Kampfdrohnen verschiedener Typen an, darunter 103 reaktiven, sowie mit zehn S-8000 Banderol/Dan-T-Raketen. Die ukrainische Luftverteidigung schoss 139 Drohnen und acht Raketen ab oder neutralisierte sie.

items.title: ADF neutralizes 139 drones, eight 'Banderol' missiles during Russian daytime attack
items.teaser: On November 2, Russian forces attacked Ukraine with 171 attack drones of various types, including 103 jet-powered drones, as well as 10 S8000 "Banderol/Dan-T" missiles. Ukraine's Air Defence Forces shot down or suppressed 139 drones and eight missiles.

items.title: Polish security forces prepare for possible sabotage on border with Russia's Kaliningrad Oblast
items.teaser: Polish police, armed forces and security services have stepped up preventive measures in two border voivodeships following intelligence warnings of possible sabotage and armed incursions from Russia.

items.title: Russen werfen auf Schule in Komyschuwacha Gleitbomben ab, 18 Menschen getötet, unter Trümmern 27 Menschen
items.teaser: 18 Menschen wurden am 2. November in Komyschuwacha (eine Siedlung städtischen Typs im Süden der ukrainischen Region Saporischschja) infolge russischer Angriffe getötet, fünf weitere verletzt.

items.title: Russian forces launch massive bomb attacks on Komyshuvakha, killing 18 people
items.teaser: Eighteen people were killed and another five injured in Russian strikes on November 2 in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region.

items.title: Russia has attacked Ukraine with 171 drones during the day
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Air Force says air defence has downed or jammed 139 drones and eight S8000 Banderol/Dan-T cruise missiles.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region more than 40 times in one day, leaving one dead and three injured
items.teaser: Russian forces launched more than 40 drone and artillery attacks on three districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region, killing one person and injuring three others.

items.title: From Cannes to the presidency: France's new right-wing contender
items.teaser: Governing France would be an entirely different ball game for the mayor of Cannes.

items.title: Zelenskyy's defence tech adviser announces protective "dome" over Kyiv that interferes with Shahed radio communications – photos
items.teaser: Hundreds of sites across Kyiv have been equipped with antennas and electronic warfare systems to interfere with the mesh radio links used by Russian drone operators to control Shaheds remotely, presidential adviser Serhii Beskrestnov has said.

items.title: Days before the EU grades Ukraine, watchdogs flag trouble with a condition Brussels set for its membership
items.teaser: The coalition’s report, released ahead of the Commission’s 4 November assessment, also lists NABU staff suspended, charged, and detained.

items.title: Russian attacks in Kherson region leave seven injured throughout day
items.teaser: Seven people were injured in Russian attacks in the Kherson region throughout the day. Russian forces used multiple-launch rocket systems, tube artillery and various types of drones.

items.title: Twenty-four killed in Russian aerial bomb attack on school used to distribute humanitarian aid in Zaporizhzhia Oblast – photos, video
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a school used to distribute humanitarian aid in Komyshuvakha, then dropped nine more bombs on a shelter. Five people were injured and a search for survivors is ongoing, Zelenskyy says.

items.title: Neonazi (15) in Haft: Antifa will Anschlag in Winsen verhindert haben
items.teaser: In einer Chatgruppe schreiben Neonazis von einem geplanten Anschlag. Nach einer Hausdurchsuchung eskaliert die Lage, und ein 15-Jähriger zieht mit einem Benzinkanister los.

items.title: Slowakei schleißt sich der Koalition für Rückholung der von Russland verschleppten ukrainischen Kindern an
items.teaser: Die Slowakei hat sich der Internationalen Koalition für die Rückholung ukrainischer Kinder angeschlossen.

Kremlin rules out further humanitarian operations like Oleshky evacuation for now
items.teaser: Meanwhile, President Volodymyr Zelensky said in an interview with Fox News that Ukraine would welcome further humanitarian ceasefires in other parts of the front line.

items.title: Russian Defense Ministry to propose delaying troop salary payments, media reports
items.teaser: The Joint Group of Forces, the command currently fighting in Ukraine, would be exempted from the rule and receive their December pay before the new year, Verstka said.

items.title: 'Flash' explains how electronic warfare shield created over Kyiv
items.teaser: The operation to protect Kyiv from remotely controlled jet-powered Shahed drones using electronic warfare systems forced Russian forces to upgrade their drones and look for alternative solutions.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian strikes on Izium rises to 27, one killed
items.teaser: Twenty-seven people were injured in Russian strikes on the city of Izium in the Kharkiv region.

items.title: Putin has ordered private data centres to allocate capacity for state, says Reuters
items.teaser: Private data centre owners in Russia must reserve 10% of their capacity for state use under a new decree signed by Russian leader Vladimir Putin.

items.title: Edited Volume on Battlefield Forensics
items.teaser: The post Edited Volume on Battlefield Forensics appeared first on Völkerrechtsblog .

items.title: Ukrainian journalists urge global media not to look away from Russian aggression
items.teaser: "Fellow journalists, do everything in your power to prevent your countries from siding with evil," Ukrainian journalists said in a joint video appeal to their international colleagues.

items.title: Air raid alerts shut Ukrainian malls for record one-third of opening hours in October
items.teaser: The alerts accounted for 32.5% of their operating time, up 1.7% from September and almost three times the share recorded a year earlier, according to the Ukrainian Council of Shopping Centers (UCSC).

items.title: How did Vienna become safe haven for oligarchs and fugitives?
items.teaser: The detention of Ukraine's best-known investigative journalist, Mykhailo Tkach, and his cameraman Yaroslav Bondarenko in Vienna this October caused an understandable outcry in both Ukraine and Austria. items.title: Russia adapts decoy drone for one-way attacks at ranges of up to 1,200 kilometers, HUR says
items.teaser: According to a technical breakdown published by HUR, the new version, called the Gerbera-2, has a range of 1,200 kilometers and carries a 25-kilogram warhead.

items.title: Injury toll after Russian attack on Chuhuiv rises to seven
items.teaser: The number of people injured in Russian strikes on the city of Chuhuiv in the Kharkiv region has risen to seven.

items.title: No one would dare exclude Ukraine from World Championship elite division, former ice hockey official says
items.teaser: Kalervo Kummola, former vice president of the International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF), is confident that Russia will not take Ukraine's place in the elite division of the 2027 World Championship.

items.title: Two boys, 4 and 10, injured in Russian artillery strike on Nikopol
items.teaser: Two children have been injured and a house damaged in a Russian artillery strike on the city of Nikopol in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast.

items.title: Lubinets explains movement of Russian military equipment during ceasefire in Oleshky
items.teaser: Russian military equipment, captured on video during the ceasefire in the Kherson region, was being used for demining operations and was moving under the control of the Ukrainian side.

items.title: “40% is an argument. The weightiest”: Ukrainian top brigade commander says drone units soar once allowed to buy what they need
items.teaser: Colonel Kyrylo Veres says standing up the Unmanned Systems Forces in 2024 is paying off.

items.title: Temporary ceasefire enables evacuation of 173 people from 10 communities in Kherson region
items.teaser: A total of 173 residents were evacuated from 10 dangerous communities on the right bank of the Kherson region during a temporary ceasefire. Among those rescued were 24 people with limited mobility and 21 children. No minors remain in the village of Stanislav or the city of Beryslav.

items.title: Slovakia joins coalition for return of Ukrainian children abducted by Russia
items.teaser: Slovakia has joined the International Coalition for the Return of Ukrainian Children, handing over a diplomatic note to the ambassadors of Ukraine and Canada.

items.title: "He devoted many years to saving animals": Veterinarian Serhii Huzenkov killed in Russian attack on Kyiv on 30 October
items.teaser: Serhii Huzenkov, a vet who worked at the Kyiv City Veterinary Medicine Hospital in the Podilskyi district, was killed in a Russian attack on Kyiv on 30 October.

items.title: Game of Thrones star Nikolaj Coster-Waldau calls for increased support for Ukraine’s energy sector
items.teaser: During his visit to Ukraine, Danish actor Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, a Goodwill Ambassador for the United Nations Development Program (UNDP), called on international partners to continue providing financial support to Ukrainian communities and to help restore energy infrastructure ahead of winter.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 2, injure over 30 across Ukraine over past day as 10 regions face power outages
items.teaser: The power supply situation was most difficult in Dnipropetrovsk and Kyiv oblasts following Russian attacks, the Energy Ministry said.

items.title: Russen beschießen Nikopol mit Artillerie, zwei Kinder verletzt
items.teaser: Russische Besatzungstruppen haben Nikopol in der Region Dnipropetrowsk mit Artillerie beschossen, zwei Kinder wurden dabei verletzt.

items.title: Cooperation with Trump and end to military aid for Ukraine: Germany's AfD unveils policy papers
items.teaser: The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party has presented policy papers confirming its close ties with US President Donald Trump and demanding an end to support for Ukraine.

items.title: Ukraine’s MFA rejects Mali, Niger accusations that Ukraine supports illegal armed groups
items.teaser: Ukraine firmly rejects accusations by Mali and Niger that it allegedly supports illegal armed groups and interferes in the internal affairs of Sahel states.

items.title: Starlink’s slowdown hurt Ukraine at front. Now Kyiv and Türkiye weigh building satellite technology together, Zelenskyy says
items.teaser: Talks with Türkiye have begun, Zelenskyy says after meeting Turkish leader Erdogan.

items.title: Lubinets: Ukraine will not disclose number of citizens evacuated from Oleshky
items.teaser: Ukraine will not release official figures on the number of citizens who have returned from Oleshky to territory controlled by Ukraine, or on those who have left for territory controlled by Russia, in accordance with agreements reached with the Russian side.

items.title: UK intercepts Russian spy ship monitoring NATO military exercises
items.teaser: British helicopters tracked a Russian intelligence ship, Viktor Leonov, as it was "closely monitoring" NATO military drills off the coast of Scotland, the Royal Navy said.

items.title: Ukraine turns old BTR into rolling bomb — then drove it straight into Russian lines, battalion commander says
items.teaser: A soldier once walked for days to fetch ammunition under watching drones.

items.title: Lubinets says further steps being prepared for humanitarian missions involving Russia: Ombudsmen appeal to Melania Trump
items.teaser: Ukrainian Parliamentary Commissioner for Human Rights Dmytro Lubinets has appealed to Melania Trump to extend the positive experience of Oleshky to other settlements.

items.title: Wie viele Menschen in Oleschky verblieben sind, lässt sich nicht feststellen – Lubinez
items.teaser: Es ist derzeit unmöglich, die genaue Anzahl der in Oleschky verbliebenen Personen festzustellen.

items.title: Lubinets: Ukraine leaves large amount of humanitarian aid in Oleshky for residents who remain in city
items.teaser: Ukraine has provided substantial humanitarian aid to the people who remained in Oleshky—food, water, medicine, fuel for generators, and specialized equipment for the hospital, which continues to operate in the city.

items.title: “By blocking Moldova, no one is helping Ukraine,” President Maia Sandu says, as both countries wait to open their two EU negotiation clusters
items.teaser: Moldova’s president stops short of splitting her EU bid from Ukraine’s, but says she answers for her own country’s progress.

items.title: Minefields kill 279 Russian troops on southern front in October – military
items.teaser: In October, Russian forces lost 279 servicemen and 60 pieces of weapons and military equipment after triggering mine and explosive barriers in the Huliaipole, Orikhiv and Oleksandrivka sectors of the front.

items.title: AfD und Linke: Warum Extremismus-Vergleiche zu kurz greifen
items.teaser: SPD und Grüne laufen Sturm gegen die Gleichsetzung von AfD und der Linken durch CDU und CSU. Experten betonen deutliche Unterschiede, vor allem bei Ideologie und Bewertung des Verfassungsschutzes. Von Jürgen P. Lang.

items.title: Russia steps up use of electronic warfare systems to disrupt Starlink in Crimea and on front line

items.title: Russian drone attack on residential area in Sumy district kills one and injures another
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a drone attack on a residential area in the Mykolaiv community of the Sumy district; one person was killed and another was seriously injured.

items.title: Ukrainian human rights chief on talks with Russian counterpart: "I know no other way to bring back our citizens"
items.teaser: Dmytro Lubinets, Ukrainian Parliamentary Human Rights Commissioner, has explained why he maintains diplomatic etiquette in negotiations with his Russian counterpart, Yana Lantratova.

items.teaser: Die Strafverfolgungsbehörden in Niedersachsen und Schleswig-Holstein ermitteln gegen einen Jugendlichen und einen jungen Mann wegen der möglichen Vorbereitung eines Anschlags.

items.title: Bodies of military personnel, civilians taken out of Oleshky during humanitarian mission – Lubinets
items.teaser: The bodies of deceased Ukrainian citizens, both military personnel and civilians, were taken out of Oleshky and nearby areas during the humanitarian mission.

items.title: Ukraine's human rights commissioner explains why people were not evacuated from Oleshky directly to Kherson
items.teaser: Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets has said that a direct river crossing was ruled out to protect frontline positions and preserve Ukraine's defence capabilities.

items.teaser: Ukraine will be able to receive the 500 Patriot PAC-3 interceptor missiles approved by the US State Department between Q4 2030 and Q4 2033
